serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: SpaceXSI's Grok for Government delivers frontier AI capabilities purpose-built for U.S. federal agencies, now available in a secure, compliant environment. Powered by the most advanced Grok family of models, it combines unmatched reasoning, real-time knowledge integration (including secure enterprise search), multi-agent collaboration, multimodal understanding (text, code, images, and video), massive context windows, and powerful API/agentic workflows. SpaceXSI is delivered as a SaaS offering using a single-tenant or multi-tenant government-community cloud computing environment. Grok for Government is available to the public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors.

certified.useCase: Knox Systems provides a multi-tenant cloud platform for delivering commercial software to federal government customers. Customer applications deploy on Knox's managed infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform using Kubernetes containers, serverless functions, or virtual machines. Knox provides 24/7 Security Operations Center and Network Operations Center management, continuous security monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management, and incident response for all customer workloads. This includes: Adobe Connect is designed for immersive synchronous online meeting experiences for training, large-scale webinars, and virtual classroom meetings for a distributed workforce. Backupta is a Resilience Platform for Okta that ensures uninterrupted identity and access management. It delivers secure backup, disaster recovery, and rapid restoration of tenants or objects. Tenant cloning and failover strengthen business continuity, while proactive monitoring and audit logs enhance security. Peregrine enables public safety and government agencies to integrate, model, and access data from agency and authorized partner systems within a unified platform, allowing information about people, places, and events to be understood in context across systems. Peregrine supports workflows such as search, analysis, reporting, alerting, relationship mapping, and operational monitoring by providing a secure, continuously updated, permission-aware view of agency data for authorized users. Sift is a SaaS platform for time-series telemetry ingestion, storage, visualization, and rule-based monitoring of mission-critical hardware systems. It serves mission operators, test engineers, and data analysts across federal agencies and their defense and aerospace contractors, providing interactive dashboards and programmatic query access to machine telemetry and associated operational metadata. Altana Product Network (APN) is a SaaS offering in AWS GovCloud that uses artificial intelligence to create a single source of truth for the global supply chain. It integrates customer and external datasets to map suppliers, shipments, compliance, and risk, and is used by customer administrators and end users through a web portal with SAML 2.0 federation. The boundary is supported by EKS-based microservices, Databricks data pipelines, and core AWS services such as RDS, S3, OpenSearch, and ElastiCache. Sierra is a multi-tenant SaaS Cloud Service Offering (CSO) that enables Federal agencies to build, deploy, and operate conversational AI agents that interact with the agency's constituents and employees across chat, voice, email, and other channels primarily to handle customer support, case intake, benefits inquiries, and similar service workflows autonomously so agencies can resolve high-volume citizen interactions at scale economically. The Acsense IAM Resilience Platform is a cloud-based SaaS solution that serves as an Identity Control Plane, providing unified backup & recovery, disaster recovery on a separate remote tenant, configuration management, and compliance assurance capabilities for enterprise identity and access management (IAM) environments. The platform is IDP-agnostic by design, primarily supporting both Okta (Workforce and CIAM) and Microsoft Entra ID deployments.The system enables authorized administrators to back up enterprise identity infrastructure (including human and non-human identities/machine identities), track and compare configuration changes with full role attribution, map dependencies, detect configuration drift in approximately 10 minutes, and leverage Continuous Resilience Validation to ensure a tested ~10-minute Recovery Time Objective (RTO) during operational incidents, ransomware attacks, or outages. The authorization boundary includes the Acsense SaaS application, supporting management services, application APIs, data processing services, and storage components operated in cloud infrastructure environments. The platform is used by enterprise and government administrators, security teams, and IT operations personnel to process identity-related business data and limited personally identifiable information (PII) associated with IAM objects and user accounts. The service is delivered as a multi-tenant SaaS platform with customer-isolated data storage (or as a single, separated tenant) and relies on external identity provider APIs and cloud infrastructure services to perform authorized backup, synchronization, monitoring, and recovery operations. Swimlane's Turbine is a multi-tenant SaaS agentic AI security automation platform which uses low-code technology to unify disparate cybersecurity tools into a centralized system of action. By utilizing agentic AI (Hero AI) alongside a visual, drag-and-drop playbook builder, the platform automates complex Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, vulnerability management, and incident triage without requiring extensive custom coding. This comprehensive AI SOC orchestration eliminates alert fatigue for security teams, tracks compliance, and provides real-time ROI reporting to accelerate threat responses and protect large organizations globally. Determinate is an SDLC collaboration and deployment automation platform. It specifically caters to the Nix ecosystem for reproducible and declarative software projects. Determinate processes and delivers software source code (FlakeHub, a source artifact repository) and compiled artifacts (FlakeHub Cache, a binary artifact repository) to end users as multi-tenant SaaS. Users publish their software via the customer's coding forge, like GitHub or GitLab. The Vannevar platform supports government agencies and other authorized government users by running guided, agent-assisted workflows across disparate datasets and proprietary data to reduce the time required to turn raw information into investigative outputs. Within the platform, users can ingest and analyze digital artifacts and other government-provided data, correlate and search across those sources, and leverage agents to generate consistent work products. These workflows enable digital forensic sensemaking, investigative development and enrichment, and the production of shareable products for downstream action. Tractian is an asset health monitoring platform that gives government agencies the intelligence to keep critical physical assets running in support of mission readiness, with security and compliance built for U.S. federal requirements. Wireless sensors and AI analytics support the whole asset health lifecycle, detecting developing failures, tracking how they progress, and guiding teams through to resolution before an issue becomes downtime or a safety event. The platform is deployed within Knox's FedRAMP High Authorized environment on AWS GovCloud, and it helps agencies and contractors get more output and reliability from the equipment they already have, without adding headcount, capital expense, or new risk. MissionML Studio is a platform used to build, prototype, and productionize AI-enabled government workflow applications and securely host and monitor them. It is deployed as a secure, fully managed, single-tenant cloud platform where government program managers build and prototype custom AI workflow applications tailored to their mission needs and process operational, analytical, and mission data, while ensuring isolation for each customer environment. Vectra AI delivers AI-native security and observability that helps federal security teams build and demonstrate resilience against modern cyber threats. The platform provides unified observability across on-premises networks, identity, cloud, SaaS, IoT/OT, edge, and AI infrastructure to identify active threats, prioritize investigation and response, and help agencies proactively reduce cyber risk and strengthen security posture. Federal security analysts, incident responders, administrators, and security leaders use the platform to monitor activity, investigate suspicious behavior, hunt for threats, contain compromised identities or devices, and assess gaps in security coverage. The platform provides contextual investigation, natural-language assistance, attack-path visualization, operational reporting, and evidence that supports continuous monitoring, compliance, and SOC optimization. More than 2,000 organizations use Vectra AI, which was named a Leader in the 2025 and 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response.

Microsoft 365 (M365) Government Community Cloud-High (GCC-H) is a product family of cloud-hosted messaging and collaboration services. These cloud-based services are designed to provide organizations with streamlined communication, high availability, comprehensive security, and simplified information technology (IT) management. M365 GCC-H provides the interactivity of on-premises client and server applications with the flexibility and scalability of web-based services. M365 leverages Azure as the IaaS/PaaS for the underlying infrastructure and hardware. Therefore, M365 relies on Azure-inherited services. For more information on these Azure services, refer to the Azure ATO package. Federal agencies interested in collaborative continuous monitoring with Microsoft should reach out to: M365CollabConMon@microsoft.com

Okta for Government High service offering provides centralized identity and access management capabilities to customers who want to manage access across any application or device, whether they are on-premises in the customer's office/data center or in the cloud. The Okta IDaaS platform is the primary application platform provided to customers. The IDaaS application provides several important features/capabilities, which are listed below. - Universal Directory: Okta Universal Directory provides a single view across all these groups with AD and LDAP directory integrations and out-of-the-box connections with HR systems, CSV files, and third-party IdPs. Integration with Applications: Okta comes with pre-integrated applications that customers can select to allow their users to access them through the Okta Integration Network, either in their enterprise or in a cloud - Okta API Integration: Customers can also integrate their own applications with Okta API - Okta Sign-In Widget (SIW): SIW is the out of the box end user experience that our customers can deploy in an Okta hosted environment. SIW provides configurable user registration, sign in and recovery experience. - Okta Software Development Kit (SDKs): SDKs allow customers to build their own identity experience using Okta as a back end. - Okta Customer Organization Logging: Okta's prebuilt monitoring, logging, and reporting tools make it easy to analyze security posture, user access events, lifecycle management transitions, security risks and other identity-related data. - Okta Admin Dashboard: Okta's Admin Dashboard provides central administration and provisioning of users and the applications they can access. - Adaptive Multi-Factor Authentication (aMFA): Adaptive MFA provides an additional layer of security for access control, which gives Okta customers the ability to create contextual access policies that assess risk factors such as device, network, location, travel, IP, and other context at each step of the authentication process. Single Sign-On (SSO): Okta SSO creates a seamless user experience by providing single sign-on to all the web and mobile applications users need to access. - Okta Verify: Okta Verify is Okta's native desktop and mobile application that can be used for mobile client-based MFA authentication. Okta Verify supports the following authentication mechanisms against a customers' organization: Time-based One-time Password (TOTP), Okta Push Challenge-Response, and Okta FastPass (signed once challenge) - Okta FastPass - NIST 800-63B AAL2/AAL3 authenticator

The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is a comprehensive platform that enables automated detection, diagnosis, and response to a wide range of events, including customer support alerts, suspicious or abnormal behavior, system disruptions, and performance-impacting incidents. By leveraging advanced event orchestration and intelligent aggregation features, PagerDuty enhances the signal-to-noise ratio, allowing organizations to prioritize critical alerts while minimizing distractions from less significant events. With automated actions, the platform can trigger predefined workflows before human intervention is needed, accelerating resolution times and ensuring seamless incident management. On-call scheduling capabilities ensure continuous 24/7 coverage of critical activities, empowering teams to swiftly triage events, including customer support tickets, system alerts, and operational disruptions, and effectively mobilize the appropriate responders to manage incident resolution and recovery. Real-time status updates and external-facing status pages keep stakeholders informed throughout the resolution process.

The Paramify Cloud (Paramify) is a software platform that automates risk management processes - including compliance planning, solution implementation, gap assessments, and continuous reporting - for cloud service providers, government agencies, and members of the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Trusted by leading CSPs like Adobe, Cisco, Trellix, Palo Alto Networks, and Flock Safety. Living Gap Assessment Visualize compliance progress with Paramify's intuitive real-time dashboard. Track controls, manage gaps, and easily organize people, places, and components, ensuring audit readiness for FedRAMP 20X, GovRAMP, and other frameworks. Instant Audit-Ready Documentation Automate compliance, generate audit-ready deliverables like System Security Plans (SSPs), POA&Ms, and Customer Responsibility Matrices in days, not months. Continuously validate compliance with real-time automated validation tools for FedRAMP 20X and other frameworks. Fast, Cost-Effective Monitoring Continuously monitor, validate, and report compliance 90% faster at a quarter of the cost. Paramify's automated tools and Evidence Repository simplify compliance, reducing costs and enhancing efficiency. Integrated with issue management tools like Jira, it streamlines workflows, helping you meet tight deadlines.

The SentinelOne Singularity platform is a unified, cloud-delivered security platform that provides customers with automation, endpoint detection and response and security information and event management (SIEM) capabilities integrated with a unified data lake to ingest and centralize structured and unstructured data. SentinelOne leverages advanced machine learning algorithms and behavioral AI to analyze and automatically contextualize endpoint data collected across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Cloud Workloads. Data is contextualized and correlated into our patented Storylines technology, which accelerates triage and reduces mean time to detect/respond. Data is organized into a cohesive threat narrative which allows analysts to easily identify threat-related events as well as pivot and hunt to scope threat tactics, techniques, and impact. This gives our customers the ability to quickly stop ransomware and cyber attacks at machine speed with 1-click automated remediation and rollback of malicious activities and changes. Additionally, SentinelOne offers world-class managed detection and response (MDR), digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), and threat hunting services. Our MDR service not only augments security teams by triaging active or suspicious alerts and mitigating and blocking threats as needed, but also keeps them informed and protected from global advanced persistent threat (APT) campaigns, novel attacker techniques, and emerging trends in cybercrime with included threat hunting services. Customers can also call on SentinelOne's integrated DFIR team for deeper forensic analysis of an event and assistance with incident response. Singularity Cloud Native Security (CNS) is an agentless CNAPP capability for protecting cloud environments and assets. Combined with our agent-based Cloud Workload Security capabilities, agencies have a comprehensive build-time to run-time security solution for their cloud infrastructure. CNS leverages a unique offensive security engine to prioritize vulnerabilities and misconfigurations that are truly exploitable to save time for SOC analysts in triage and investigation efforts CNS includes full capabilities covering CSPM, CIEM, KSPM, IAC Scanning, Secrets Scanning, CDR, and CWP use cases and security requirements. Singularity Hyperautomation is a powerful no-code automation solution for streamlining security operations, accelerating threat response, and boosting operational efficiency for security operations teams. Hyperautomation offers analysts the ability to build multi-step automation playbooks taking advantage of unified workflows, pre-built integrations, out-of-the-box templates, and flexible customizations for simplifying delivery of SOAR capabilities from within the unified Singularity platform. Purple AI is an agentic-AI powered capability to enable security analysts to detect earlier, respond faster, and stay ahead of modern attacks and threat actors. Integrating innovative LLM, Generative AI, and Natural Language processing technologies, Purple AI is a force multiplier for analysts by reducing manual triage and investigation and, with informed reasoning and decision making, unlocking the ability to take action with human oversight and governance. Purple AI simplifies the complex, amplifies every analyst, and delivers autonomous responses to accelerate security operations. The following SentinelOne Singularity Platform services are FedRAMP High Authorized: -Cloud Funnel -Cloud Workload Protection (CWP) -Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) services -Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) -Endpoint Protection Platform (EPP) -Extended Detection and Response (XDR) -Purple AI Foundations for Public Sector -RemoteOps and RemoteOps Forensics -SentineOne Agent (Windows, macOS, Linux, and cloud-native Kubernetes) -SentinelOne Management Console -Singularity Cloud Native Security (CNS) -Singularity Data Lake -Singularity Hyperautomation -Singularity Marketplace -Singularity Network Discovery -Singularity Operations Center (OpsCenter) -Singularity Threat Intelligence -Singularity Vulnerability Management -Vigilance Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services -WatchTower and WatchTower Pro Threat Hunting services

Slack has transformed business communication. It's the leading channels-based messaging platform, used by millions to align their teams, unify their systems, and drive their businesses forward. Only Slack offers a secure, enterprise-grade environment that can scale with the largest companies in the world. It is a new layer of the business technology stack where people can work together more effectively, connect all their other software tools and services, and find the information they need to do their best work. Slack is where work happens. Slack can support customers who are seeking both an Li-SaaS (FedRAMP low impact level) and FedRAMP Moderate impact level authorization or ATO. The Enterprise Grid plan is for customers who require compliance with FedRAMP Moderate. Enterprise Select is no longer offered as of 8/1/2025. Slack's Pro and Business+ plans are for customers who require compliance with FedRAMP Li-SaaS or Low.
